crossRefs.note: Jesus said therefore to the twelve, “You don’t also want to go away, do you?”
Then the maid who kept the door said to Peter, “Are you also one of this man’s disciples?” He said, “I am not.”
Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said therefore to him, “You aren’t also one of his disciples…
That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It’s the Lord!” So when Simon Peter heard that it was the…
So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than…
He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?”
Simon Peter answered, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
The Lord said, “Simon, Simon, behold, Satan asked to have all of you, that he might sift you as wheat,
but I prayed for you, that your faith wouldn’t fail. You, when once you have turned again, establish your brothers.”

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: Then Simon Peter came, following him, and entered into the tomb. He saw the linen cloths lying,
translations.bsb: Simon Peter arrived just after him. He entered the tomb and saw the linen cloths lying there.
translations.kjv: Then cometh Simon Peter following him, and went into the sepulchre, and seeth the linen clothes lie,
translations.asv: Simon Peter therefore also cometh, following him, and entered into the tomb; and he beholdeth the linen cloths lying,
